reasoning: The gazette content is the official publication of a Collective Agreement between a company and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act. This constitutes a regulatory/legal notice, as it formally publishes a legally binding agreement in accordance with an existing statute (Chapter 131). It falls under the Legal/Regulatory category as it deals with subsidiary legislation and compliance requirements stemming from a principal Act. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or fit the other specialized categories like Land, Commercial, etc.
